title: #Coronavirus or #Chinesevirus?!: Understanding the negative sentiment reflected in Tweets with racist hashtags across the development of COVID-19
reasoning: The paper is a sociological study that analyzes human-generated racist and xenophobic sentiment on Twitter using traditional sentiment analysis tools (VADER) and keyword extraction. It does not evaluate or benchmark religious, moral, or ethical systems in the context of AI or Large Language Models; rather, it identifies the presence of these sentiments in human discourse.
